row_order: north_to_south (grid row 1 / result lat index 0 is the northern edge)
method: Lagoon and Klaipėda strait, 1576 sea cells (the coastal Baltic of the model domain, 758 cells, dropped: api/scripts/curonian_lagoon_grid.py). Trimmed to the lagoon from: Exact: a 0.009 x 0.0158 degree lat/lon grid (about 1 km cells) over the 29-box Curonian Lagoon model domain (lagoon, Klaipėda strait, coastal Baltic); a cell is sea when at least 50% of the 200 m water mask in it is water, plus the cells the strait thalweg crosses; only the largest connected body is kept.
